question: CI topology / startup waits
stop_when_true: Real Performance Tests topology preserves row ordering, retained counts, failures, first-key tails, and resource placement.
expand_if: CI changes ordering, variance, failures, or resource timing relative to local rows.
decision_if_pass: Change wait policy only after the real topology artifact passes.
minimum_artifact: Raw CI retained samples plus q25/q50/q75/cnt, failures, first-key distributions, resources, and environment metadata.

question: Pattern-loading wait
stop_when_true: Source-specific readiness plus resource quiet preserves preview/canvas behavior and retained samples across lanes.
expand_if: Hidden readiness work, preview/canvas failure, or resource movement enters the measured window.
decision_if_pass: Remove fixed sleeps only for the specs whose readiness predicate passes.
minimum_artifact: Per-spec readiness/resource artifact with fallback logs and preview/canvas/actionability counts.

question: Selector/source guards
stop_when_true: Behavior fixtures pass and source-span fanout collapses for the targeted owner before aggregate p50 is cited.
expand_if: Behavior changes, source spans do not collapse, or the aggregate win appears without source evidence.
decision_if_pass: Land only behavior-gated source guards with matching source-span collapse.
minimum_artifact: Focused unit/behavior fixtures plus source-span microscope and matched aggregate check.

question: Store subscriber partition
stop_when_true: Public subscription, dynamic dependency, race, and persistence-selector fixtures pass with listener-count collapse.
expand_if: Any compatibility fixture fails or the filtered lane changes public @wordpress/data semantics.
decision_if_pass: Prototype only after narrower source ownership is proved.
minimum_artifact: Compatibility fixture suite plus marker-only listener/source-span collapse.

question: Runtime mechanism
stop_when_true: Trace-off sidecar preserves class ordering and joins a differentiating runtime state to retained key windows.
expand_if: Observer placement perturbs ordering or no joined runtime field separates fast and slow classes.
decision_if_pass: Name Chromium/runtime state only when the sidecar join passes.
minimum_artifact: Trace-off protocol sidecar with runtime checkpoints, timebase sync, and retained-key joins.

question: CPU/QoS mechanism
stop_when_true: Sidecar plus powermetrics separates fast and slow classes by frequency, residency, QoS, power, or runnable state.
expand_if: Counters do not separate rows, requiring root trace or an empirical-only conclusion.
decision_if_pass: Name CPU/QoS mechanism only after counter separation; otherwise keep empirical CPU-state sensitivity.
minimum_artifact: Accepted sidecar plus root powermetrics and optional root trace fallback.

question: Product workload
stop_when_true: Replay strata show the same owner/effect pattern for the product claim being made.
expand_if: Correction, selection, paste, structure, IME, media/pattern, or plugin-heavy strata diverge.
decision_if_pass: Generalize only to covered strata; keep fixed-x claims scoped otherwise.
minimum_artifact: Synthetic and recorded replay strata with assertions, endpoints, and per-stratum source spans.

question: Presentation endpoint
stop_when_true: External glyph/display timing agrees with Chromium-internal screenshot/paint endpoints for retained keys.
expand_if: External endpoint ordering differs or cannot be joined without perturbing the benchmark.
decision_if_pass: Claim only Chromium-internal visual propagation unless external calibration passes.
minimum_artifact: External OCR/template/present/camera calibration joined per retained key.
